api_keys_error_expiry: Choose a date after today, or none.
api_keys_error_missing: That API key no longer exists.
api_keys_expires_hint: Optional. The key stops working after this day (UTC).
api_keys_lead: Keys give scripts and other apps access to the REST API at /api/v1 and the MCP server.
api_keys_new_lead: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be read again.
api_keys_revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}? Anything using it stops working at once.
api_keys_revoke_confirm_copy: Revoke {name}? Anything using it stops working at once, and its copy in the Vault is deleted.
api_keys_revoked_copy: API key revoked and its copy in the Vault deleted.
api_keys_vault: Save a copy in the Vault
api_keys_vault_hint: The key is still shown here only once. Its copy can be revealed in the Vault after you confirm your identity, and revoking the key deletes the copy.
api_keys_vault_saved: A copy is saved in the Vault.
basemaps_attribution_hint: Shown in the corner of the map as plain text, for example the name of the provider.
basemaps_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? If it is in use, the maps go back to the standard basemap.
basemaps_empty: No basemaps added yet. The maps show the standard one.
basemaps_lead: Basemaps lie beneath the geometries of Map Notes. The one in use shows on every map, and the Basemap button on the map switches between them.
basemaps_url_hint: An https address with {placeholders}, such as {example}. It may also use {extras}.
data_export_key_warning: The export holds neither ENCRYPTION_KEY nor BETTER_AUTH_SECRET. Keep both somewhere safe on their own: without ENCRYPTION_KEY the vault of a restored backup cannot be read, and with another BETTER_AUTH_SECRET two factor sign in stops working.
data_export_lead: One archive with the database, the uploaded files and a manifest, the same as the backup command writes. Restore it with the restore command. Downloading asks for your password first.
data_export_running: An export is already running. Try again when it has finished.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
files_error_upload_rate: Too many uploads. Wait a minute and try again.
login_code_sent_notice: A sign in code has been sent.
login_error_code_send: A code could not be sent to that address.
login_error_two_factor_expired: The sign in took too long. Start again.
login_error_two_factor_locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
login_meta_description: Sign in with a username or email and a password, or with an email code.
login_two_factor_lead: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
mail_ignore: If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this mail. Nobody can use it without access to your inbox.
mail_new_sign_in_body: Your account was just signed in from a browser it has not seen before.
mail_new_sign_in_warning: If this was not you, change your password and sign out the other sessions in Settings.
mail_notice_reason: This is an automatic security notice for the owner of this account.
mail_password_changed_body: The password of your account was just changed.
mail_password_changed_warning: If you did not do this, reset the password right away and sign out every other session.
mail_reset_body: Use this code to set a new password. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
mail_sign_in_body: Use this code to sign in. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
map_basemap_failed: The basemap could not be changed.
map_delete_confirm: Delete this geometry? Its note stays.
map_error_geometry_invalid: The geometry is not valid, for example a shape that crosses itself.
map_error_geometry_type: Only pins, lines and polygons can be stored.
map_error_missing: That geometry or note no longer exists.
map_error_too_many_vertices: A geometry can have at most {max} points.
map_location_empty: This note has no location yet.
map_note_failed: The note could not be loaded.
map_pending_text: Link this geometry to a note.
map_save_failed: The geometry could not be saved.
notes_conflict: This note was changed somewhere else. Your edit is not saved yet.
notes_delete_confirm: Delete {title} for good? This cannot be undone.
notes_error_content: The note content is not valid.
notes_error_image: Images must be uploaded to this instance.
notes_error_link: Links must start with http://, https:// or mailto:.
notes_error_not_trashed: Only notes in the trash can be deleted for good.
notes_error_too_large: The note is larger than 2 MB.
notes_save_failed: The note could not be saved.
notes_trash_description: Notes in the trash are deleted for good after {days} days.
notes_upload_failed: The image could not be uploaded.
reset_code_resent: A new verification code has been sent.
reset_error_send: A code could not be sent right now.
reset_lead_request: Enter your email and a verification code will be sent to it.
reset_lead_verify_after: Enter it below with your new password.
reset_meta_description: Reset your Manifold password with a verification code.
reset_success: Password updated. You can log in now.
search_meta_description: Search notes, services and the vault.
security_backup_codes_created: New backup codes created. The old ones no longer work.
security_backup_codes_lead: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once when your authenticator is not at hand. They are shown only now.
security_backup_codes_new_lead: Replaces every backup code you have with a new set.
security_error_setup: The setup expired. Start it again.
security_meta_description: Two factor authentication, sessions and the audit log.
security_two_factor_disable_lead: Signing in will need only your password or an emailed code again.
security_two_factor_lead: Signing in will also ask for a code from an authenticator app. Enter your password to start.
security_two_factor_manual: Or type this key into the app:
security_two_factor_qr: QR code for your authenticator app
security_two_factor_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
services_error_order: The order did not match the current services. Reload and try again.
services_icon_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to {max} MB.
services_meta_description: Links to the services this instance keeps track of.
settings_error_current_password: The current password is not correct.
settings_error_email_taken: That email address is already in use.
settings_error_generic: The change could not be saved.
settings_locale_hint: Used for security notices, such as a new sign in, and for mails sent while you are not using the app.
settings_password_saved: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings_theme_hint: Browsers that have not chosen a theme start with this one.
step_up_confirmed: Confirmed. Sensitive actions are open for ten minutes.
step_up_lead: Enter your password to continue. You will not be asked again for ten minutes.
step_up_lead_two_factor: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app to continue. You will not be asked again for ten minutes.
validation_basemap_zoom: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
validation_file_too_large: The file is larger than {max} MB.
validation_file_type_icon: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG image.
validation_file_type_image: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
validation_identifier: Enter a valid username or email address.
validation_password_common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
validation_password_context: The password must not contain the product, organization or account name.
validation_service_url: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
validation_username: Use {min} to {max} lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
vault_api_key_copy: Copy of an API key. Revoking the key under Settings → API Keys deletes it.
vault_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Its value is gone for good.
vault_new_value_hint: Leave empty to keep the current value. Changing it asks for your password.
vault_value_hint: Encrypted before it is stored. Shown only after you confirm your identity.
